hypotheses.persona: A shift worker (likely in construction, maintenance, or a trade) who works a rotating schedule: early morning shifts (departure ~05:00-05:30, return ~14:30) on some days, and later shifts (departure ~13:30, return ~22:30) on others. The consistent use of work badge, keys, thermos, and hi-vis vest indicates a physical job. The laptop and phone are taken to work on early shifts but left at home on later shifts, suggesting they are used for work communication or documentation only during certain shifts. The pattern across days 0-3 showed early departures (Mon-Wed) and a late departure on Thursday. Friday showed a late shift. Saturday and Sunday show relaxed days at home with meals, phone use, and no work items leaving the home. This is consistent with a weekend off. Day 7 (Monday) confirmed an early shift. Day 8 (Tuesday) showed another early shift. Day 9 (Wednesday) shows an early shift. Day 10 (Thursday) shows a late shift: hi-vis vest, keys, and phone leave at 13:29, and return at 22:29 with keys, laptop, phone, and work badge. This matches the late shift pattern seen on previous Thursdays and Fridays. Day 11 (Friday) shows a late shift departure at 13:22 and return at 22:16, with keys, thermos, and work badge leaving, and keys, laptop, and work badge returning. The laptop was not taken to work (consistent with late shift pattern). The work badge was placed on the entry hook upon return (different from previous late shift nightstand placement, but still consistent with a late shift). The shift worker hypothesis remains extremely strong.
